about: Range: which foreign land mobile stations are near enough, and on a frequency, for the propagation method to apply.
earth_radius_basis: Mean Earth radius, for great-circle distances.
max_km_basis: Recommendation ITU-R P.1546-6 applies to paths up to 1,000 km.
frequency_basis: Recommendation ITU-R P.1546-6 applies from 30 MHz to 4,000 MHz.
area_stations: A station filed as a circle is measured from the edge of its circle nearest Finland (worst case).

reasons.withdrawn: The filing withdraws a station (SUPPRESS). A withdrawn station transmits nothing new.
reasons.too_far: It is more than 1,000 km from Finland's outer limit, beyond the range of the propagation method.
reasons.out_of_band: Its frequency is outside 30–4,000 MHz, where the propagation method does not apply.

notes: Distance is to the nearest point of Finland's outer limit (land border or 12-nautical-mile territorial sea, spec/tables/finland.json); 0 inside it.
A station without a position goes on; the Data step asks for it.
Reasons are tried in the order above.
